faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mumbai Port Authority Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) post is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum experience required for the Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) role?
faq.answer: A minimum of twelve years of experience in an executive cadre in Planning, Construction, Design, or Maintenance is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for direct recruitment is 42 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) position?
faq.answer: The pay scale for the Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) post is Rs. 80000-220000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are invited through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Deputy Chief Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: The selection process is merit-based, and the overall grading in APARs should not be below 'Very Good'.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
